Treatment summary
Patient presented following a low-speed collision in a parking lot with complaints of neck and back pain. The reported
mechanism of injury is consistent with the clinical picture seen on examination, and the complaints are plausible for a
crash of this kind. Over the course of 22 visits, the patient received a standard conservative regimen including manual
therapy, therapeutic exercise, and home stretching instructions. Care followed a typical progression and tapered as
symptoms improved. Imaging and physical examination findings clearly confirm the presence of soft tissue injury to
the cervical and lumbar regions. The patient's history shows treatment to the same body area within the past two
years, and this prior condition contributes to some of the current symptoms and should be considered when
assessing present function. Billing records reflect single, non-duplicated charges for the services rendered. Patient is
expected to continue home exercise and return as needed.

injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.

it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
